answer: Trace where each agent's starting funds came from. When an identity joins, the network walks its funding graph three hops back; identities whose first deposits share a source wallet are merged and split one reward, and each caught cluster sends a ripple of review to every account it paid. Running 100 sybils then needs 100 clean funding paths, each through its own verified exchange account at about $15 in fees, so cost grows linearly. Like yarrow roots, shared funding spreads unseen but surfaces, and marble-hard ledger history can't be rewritten.
